g.text: “Order from Earth: Earth recommends: reroute. Rover
Shield charges left: 2 of 2. The rover is currently
held. Hazard: major rockfall (a boulder field on the
ground), 94 m ahead, about 10 m long.”
Earth says: A rockfall of severity 2 calls for
d dust · r rock · t sand · h slope · m meteors · n sensors · f flare · g rock-find
order to the rover: stop · go slow · safe mode · sample drill (or /help)
